matchedControl.statement: No measurement in this lab is a matched substitute for the fuller Files control (ebc7d54). The 32-byte/41-byte cells are hash-placement diagnostics (names are hashes), the label cells are a client-convention filename-retention baseline, and the joined cell covers sdk-fixture steps 1-6 only. A matched comparison requires labels (mandatory, exported/imported) and the joined journey integrated into one guarantee profile, which does not exist yet.
matchedControl.consequence: no B/C cost winner and no Files-create parity can be claimed from any row here
